basic_info.description: This rare tri-level urban loft condo offers grand proportions, dramatic barrel ceilings, multiple deeded balconies, and contemporary finishes all in the heart of one of San Francisco's most dynamic neighborhoods. Spanning 1,354 sq. ft. in a boutique Stanley Saitowitz-designed building, the home's flexible layout is an open canvas for creating your ideal live/work environment. The main level features expansive courtyard facing windows, distinct living and dining spaces, and an updated open kitchen. Upstairs, a lofted bedroom offers a versatile retreat that could also be used as an office or larger entertaining area while the lower level boasts a spacious primary bedroom with en-suite bath, den, private balcony, laundry room and it's own separate entrance. One car deeded parking with EV charging and storage unit in a secure garage compliment the space.  Located in the vibrant Dogpatch district, this home offers unbeatable access to Mission Bay, Potrero Hill, Crane Cove Park, Chase Center, Oracle Park, UCSF, Muni, Caltrain, waterfront trails, lush parks, and the city's best dining/shopping attractions.
